messages.subject: TTW | Water infrastructure, sustainability and institutional strategy
messages.body:
Dear TTW Leadership Team,

Water security and utility reliability sit at the core of industrial and community resilience. TTW's infrastructure platform aligns strongly with my experience managing environmental, regulatory and public-private stakeholder priorities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I work across environmental agencies, communities, operations and technical teams on high-scrutiny resource and compliance matters. I also support energy-transition and carbon-governance work, which strengthens my broader sustainability perspective.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand roles across Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or infrastructure stakeholder leadership. I have attached a TTW-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
